% A one-page web profile: the shape of a personal site, invented person and
% invented text throughout. Exercises the webpage class — the build intent
% (html + the llms.txt twin) and the unnumbered headings are the class's own —
% plus a named stylesheet, section anchors, and in-page navigation.

\documentclass{webpage}

\pdfmeta{
  author  = "Alex Doe",
  title   = "Alex Doe",
  subject = "Alex Doe keeps an invented orchard.",
  url     = "https://example.org/alex",
  image   = "https://example.org/alex/card.png",
  favicon = "favicon.svg",
}

\output{
  css = own,
  stylesheet = "webpage.css",
}

\palette{
  accent = #B22222,
  muted  = #66707A,
}

\begin{document}
